_note: Episode 5 keyframes (Treaty of Paris, 10 Dec 1898). Shot rules: close-ups, one plate per location, characters on flat green then composited (pipeline/make_keys.py). All NVIDIA FLUX.2 klein drafts; upgrade with Figma by saving the same name as .png. Usman only in the Paris shots, never in San Juan. Real people (commissioners, Agoncillo) are generic figures, not likenesses. Indio's tattoos are hidden under the coat in Paris; the tattoo frame shows five.

plates.street: a wet city street in Manila today just after rain, the stone gate and facade of a Catholic church on one side, puddles reflecting grey sky, a parked motorcycle with a square insulated delivery box, power lines, acacia tree, soft overcast light.
plates.church: Single image, no panels, no border, no black bars, the picture fills the whole vertical frame. The quiet side aisle of an old church in Manila, Philippines, on a rainy afternoon: cream walls, marble floor, wooden pews, a plain white marble slab in the wall with nothing on it, candles, grey rain light from tall windows; blank walls, no plaques, no signs, no writing, no letters.
plates.paris: a Paris street on a freezing December night in 1898, tall cream stone buildings with wrought-iron balconies, glowing gas street lamps, light snow on the cobblestones, one row of tall brightly lit windows on one large ornate building, deep blue night sky.
plates.salon: an ornate gilded French salon hall at night in 1898, crystal chandeliers, tall mirrors, red velvet curtains, a very long table covered in green cloth with papers, inkwells and pens, empty carved chairs, warm golden lamp light.
plates.room: a small modest Paris hotel room at night in 1898, a plain wooden desk with an oil lamp, stacks of papers and an inkwell, a narrow bed, a window showing snow falling over rooftops, warm lamp glow against cold blue shadows.
plates.manila: Single image, no panels, no border, no black bars, the picture fills the whole vertical frame. The old grey stone walls and gate of Intramuros, Manila, Philippines, by the bay in 1898, solid stone with no holes, grey steel warships with funnels anchored offshore, palm trees, hazy tropical afternoon light, empty of people.
plates.province: a Philippine provincial town in 1898 at sunrise, nipa and bamboo houses, coconut palms, green rice fields, a dirt road, distant blue mountain, golden morning light.

full.intro: A swirling golden time portal of clock gears and glowing light fills the whole background. In front of it, waist-up: a young Filipino man, about twenty, lean, warm brown skin, tousled black hair tied in a small topknot, red cloth headband with long tails, wearing a long dark grey wool overcoat with the collar turned up and a cream knitted scarf, a round bronze medallion on a cord around his neck, smiling calmly with arms crossed, and next to him a medium-sized black Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck. Golden rim light.
full.medallion: extreme close-up of a brown hand holding an old round bronze medallion engraved with a sun and a triangle on a worn cord, the medallion glowing bright gold with sparks and light rays, dark background.
full.marker: Single image, no panels. Inside the Santuario del Santo Cristo church in San Juan: close-up of a blank weathered bronze plate fixed to a white marble church wall, the plate smooth and empty with only a thin raised border, no writing, no letters; two lit votive candles and white flowers below it, grey rain light. No people.
full.bill: Cel-shaded anime illustration with clean ink lines and flat colours, not a photo. Single image, no panels, no border, the picture fills the whole vertical frame. Inside an old church in Manila, Philippines: close-up of a small tightly folded orange paper note tucked into the thin gap between a white marble slab and the cream wall, only its plain blank outside visible, no writing, no letters, no marks, no hands, no people; candlelight, a blurred church aisle behind.
full.skyline: the rooftops of Paris on a snowy December night in 1898, the iron Eiffel Tower in the distance, chimneys with smoke, glowing gas lamps, falling snow, deep blue sky with a pale moon. No people.
full.treaty: Single image, no panels. Paris, a gilded salon in December 1898: extreme close-up of an elderly hand in a black sleeve and white cuff holding a steel pen over a sheet of blank parchment on a green cloth table, the hand and a large red wax seal with a red ribbon cover the middle of the sheet, seen at a low angle; blank parchment, no writing, no letters, no marks on the paper; golden lamp light, gilded room blurred behind.
full.money: extreme close-up of tall stacks of gold coins and a leather money satchel on a green cloth table, a hand in a black sleeve pushing the coins across the table toward another waiting hand, golden lamp light.
full.map: Single image, no panels. A gilded Paris salon in 1898: extreme close-up of an antique parchment map of a tropical island archipelago on a green cloth table, only coastlines, green islands and blue sea drawn, no labels, no writing, no letters, no symbols; one hand in a black sleeve sliding the map across to another hand, golden lamp light.
full.war: a wooden bridge over a river at night in the tropics in 1899, bright orange flashes on both banks, thick smoke drifting, palm tree silhouettes, stars, dramatic. No people visible.
full.senate: a large nineteenth-century assembly hall seen from the back, rows of curved wooden desks, many men in dark suits seen from behind with some raising a hand to vote, tall columns, daylight from a glass ceiling.
full.coins: Single image, no panels, no border, the picture fills the whole vertical frame. Paris at night in 1898: extreme close-up of one open brown palm, a thumb and four fingers, holding exactly two large plain smooth silver coins with blank faces and blank rims, no markings, no letters, no numbers; cold blue night light, snowy street blurred behind.
full.tattoo: Single image, no panels, no border, the picture fills the whole vertical frame. Extreme close-up of the inner side of a brown-skinned forearm resting horizontally across the frame, an orange jacket sleeve pushed up at the elbow, exactly five small indigo geometric tattoo symbols in one straight row from the elbow to the wrist, evenly spaced, the fifth symbol nearest the wrist glowing gold; wet Manila street after rain blurred behind, plain walls, no signs, no writing. Only the forearm, no face, no fingers.
